Lower Text: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
Upper Text: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 [Tapirmon] and 1 2-color black card among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order. [Your Turn] When one of your Digimon would digivolve into a 2-color black Digimon card, you may suspend this Tamer to reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
